svg.title: ConvertPDF codebase workflow diagram
svg.desc: A structural flowchart showing how ConvertPDF routes user requests through static HTML pages, shared scripts, a tool loader, and individual tool JS files to perform client-side PDF operations.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the ConvertPDF homepage and navigation')
sendPrompt('What does styles.css do in ConvertPDF?')
sendPrompt('What does utils.js do in ConvertPDF?')
sendPrompt('What does components.js do in ConvertPDF?')
sendPrompt('What does script.js do in ConvertPDF?')
sendPrompt('Explain how tools/loader.js works in ConvertPDF')
g.text: Detects page, finds render function, calls it with timeout guard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What CDN libraries does ConvertPDF use and why?')
g.text: pdf-lib, pdf.js, mammoth, KaTeX, Prism, JSZip, Tesseract, QRCode…

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a tool render function work in ConvertPDF?')
g.text: tools/*.js — injects HTML, wires events, drop zones

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does file drop and drag-and-drop work in ConvertPDF?')
sendPrompt('How does ConvertPDF process files entirely in the browser?')
g.text: showSpinner → CDN lib transforms file → hideSpinner

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ConvertPDF deliver the output file to the user?')
g.text: Blob URL → browser download, memory cleaned up

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do toast notifications and related tools work in ConvertPDF?')
